targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: [failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1017_2026-09-09, user-ratified with red-team] V3-EXQ-1017 (2026-09-09, ree-cloud-2, 4m35s, 3 seeds, 7 arms) NON-CONTRIBUTORY for both ARC-138 and INV-104. The pre-registered sensitivity witness C0 failed -- max objective-choice contrast 0.0326/0.0078/0.0041 per seed against a 0.05 bar, 0 of 3 -- short-circuiting the verdict grid before either load-bearing criterion could carry a verdict. THE DRIVER'S SELF-ROUTE IS UPHELD IN FULL, INCLUDING ITS REFUSAL TO CHOOSE: it routes to p0a_objective_invisible_to_adapter_dv on the ground that 'matched control matches anchoring' and 'the DV cannot see any objective' are indistinguishable, and records neither. THIS AUTOPSY FIRST TRIED TO RESOLVE THAT AMBIGUITY AND WAS WRONG; the attempt was REFUTED at the Step 7c pass, the refutation independently verified, and recording it is part of the finding. The attempted resolution rested on own_target_r2_sense_path being negative on the trained arms. That statistic cannot bear the weight: `_own_target_r2_sense` (driver :497-510) applies the TRAINED resource_proximity_head cold to sense-path z WITHOUT REFITTING at 0.23-0.35 of the input norm it trained on (recorded: mean_norm_encoder_path 4.53-8.18 vs mean_norm_sense_path 1.36-2.30), so its sigmoid collapses toward bias -- and all nine negative values (-0.0088 to -2.7215) are exactly reproduced by a CONSTANT predictor in [0.53, 0.72], needing no claim about missing information. The companion statistic was also misread: cos(theta) between the paths is 0.686-0.855, so the 0.749-0.835 relative residual is dominated by the norm ratio, and 69-86 per cent of the sense-path DIRECTION is the encoder's output. Pointing the other way, sense-path norm is cleanly ARM-DEPENDENT (sd070_default 1.847/2.210/2.301 vs ~1.45 for both other trained arms, 3 of 3 seeds), which is direct evidence that the sense path DOES track the P0a objective; and the corpus already holds the disconfirming measurement, V3-EXQ-978's sense-path r2 of 0.710 POSITIVE from a probe fit ON that path. WHAT THIS RUN DOES ESTABLISH, AND IT IS WORTH HAVING: (a) VERIFIED -- dv_headroom_pairwise_delta passed at 0.1745 vs 0.1 with measured_cells entirely ws250_pca-minus-zworld_untrained, a width contrast, not the objective-CHOICE contrast C1/C2 test; a headroom gate computed over a different contrast class than its criterion certifies a capability the criterion never uses. (b) NEW -- the sense-path diagnostic is broken as described, and omits the pred_std its encoder-path sibling records, so the collapse is undetectable downstream. Until that probe is refit on the path it is evaluated on, NO conclusion about what sense-time z_world carries is supportable from this driver family in either direction. NEITHER CLAIM IS WEAKENED and the substantive question -- does the P0a objective choice organise z_world -- remains fully OPEN. C0 nonetheless earned its cost: without it a four-arm cluster spanning 0.669-0.679 would have been written up as 'organism-relevant anchoring does nothing'. Routing: queue-experiment, a same-question re-run whose changes are (i) refit the own-target probe on the path it is evaluated on and record pred_std, (ii) compute DV headroom over the objective-CHOICE contrast class. Substrate: AMEND dv-dynamic-range-precondition-class, NOT a create.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: AMEND, NOT CREATE -- the first draft recommended a create and the Step 7c pass correctly rejected it. The existing entry is status implemented_pending_validation, severity degrading, and its substrate_paths are already ['validate_experiments.py', 'experiments/_metrics.py::p0_readiness_gate'] -- the same module a new entry would have named. Its own governance_2026_09_04 note records a PRIOR red-team withdrawing a create in favour of an amend on this very entry, for a readout/IV-confound defect at least as distinct from DV-range as 'DV contrast class' is. The first draft cited that same governance episode for its substrate_paths-narrowing lesson and MISSED the create-versus-amend lesson, which is the more directly applicable half. TWO ADDITIONS. (1) A headroom statistic must be computed over the SAME CONTRAST CLASS as the criterion it protects. V3-EXQ-1017 passed at 0.1745 vs 0.1 measured entirely on ws250_pca-minus-zworld_untrained cells while every objective-CHOICE contrast came in under 0.033. This generalises the entry's remit from 'does the DV have RANGE' to 'does the DV have range FOR THIS CONTRAST', a natural extension of dv_headroom's existing achievable-statistic family. (2) A probe used as a readiness or diagnostic statistic must be FITTED ON THE REPRESENTATION IT IS EVALUATED ON, and must record its prediction spread. `_own_target_r2_sense` (experiments/v3_exq_1017_...py:497-510) applies a trained sigmoid head cold to a representation at 0.23-0.35 of its training norm and reports the R2 as if it measured information content; the encoder-path sibling at :470-481 returns pred_mean/pred_std, the sense-path variant returns neither. NO NEW SUBSTRATE GAP IS FOUND and no ree_core change is implicated -- harness/diagnostic discipline only. Companion amendments against this same entry come from V3-EXQ-999a (agent-arm scorability) and V3-EXQ-981a (normalisation pre-registration) in the cluster artifact; governance should apply all three in one pass.

learning_extracted: A PROBE MUST BE FITTED ON THE REPRESENTATION IT IS EVALUATED ON. Applying a head trained on one path cold to another at a third of the input norm produces a collapsed constant predictor whose R2 is arbitrarily negative, and that negative number is indistinguishable, from the manifest alone, from genuine absence of information. This is the transferable lesson and it cost this autopsy its first central inference.

RECORD THE PREDICTION SPREAD, not only the score. `_own_target_r2` returns pred_mean and pred_std; `_own_target_r2_sense` returns neither. One float would have made the collapse visible immediately -- to the driver author and to this autopsy.

A DV-HEADROOM GATE CERTIFIES HEADROOM FOR THE CONTRAST IT IS MEASURED ON, not the contrast the criterion tests. This gate passed at 0.1745 on a width contrast while every objective-choice contrast came in under 0.033. Both facts true; gate green for the wrong one.

A RATIO OF NORMS IS NOT A MEASURE OF DIFFERENT CONTENT. A relative residual of 0.78 reads as 'mostly not the same signal' and here meant 'the same direction at a third of the scale' -- cos(theta) 0.69-0.86. Decompose a residual into scale and angle before glossing it.

WHEN A DRIVER DECLINES TO CHOOSE BETWEEN TWO READINGS, TEST THE DECLINE BEFORE OVERRIDING IT. This driver explicitly refused to record either 'matched control matches anchoring' or 'the DV cannot see any objective', and that refusal was better calibrated than this autopsy's first attempt to resolve it.

A pre-registered sensitivity witness earns its cost precisely on the run where it fires: without C0, a four-arm cluster spanning 0.669-0.679 would have been written up as evidence that organism-relevant anchoring does nothing.

red_team.what_it_refuted: The first draft's central inference -- that the P0a objective is invisible to the adapter DV because the supervision is absent from the sense-path latent. REFUTED, and independently verified by this session before acceptance.
verified_by_this_session: MECHANISM, by direct code read: `_own_target_r2_sense` (driver :497-510) applies the TRAINED resource_proximity_head COLD to sense-path z with no refitting, while `_own_target_r2` (:470-481) evaluates the same head on the path it trained on. The sense-path variant also OMITS pred_mean/pred_std, which the encoder-path variant returns -- so the one diagnostic that would expose a collapsed predictor is precisely the one not recorded.

SCALE, from the manifest's own arm_results[*].sense_vs_encoder_path: mean_norm_encoder_path 4.53-8.18 against mean_norm_sense_path 1.36-2.30, i.e. the head is fed vectors at 0.23-0.35 of the norm it trained on. Through a sigmoid head that collapses the prediction toward its bias.

ARITHMETIC, by recomputation: for a CONSTANT predictor c, R2 = -(c-mu)^2/sigma^2. Solved against each recorded target_mean/target_std this reproduces ALL NINE observed negative sense-path R2 values (-0.0088 to -2.7215) with implied constants 0.530, 0.552, 0.571, 0.596, 0.612, 0.654, 0.668, 0.669, 0.715 -- squarely a sigmoid's mid-range. No claim about missing information is needed to explain any of them.

DIRECTION: cos(theta) between the two paths is 0.686-0.855, so the 0.749-0.835 relative residual is dominated by the NORM RATIO, not by directional divergence. The first draft's gloss -- 'about 80 per cent of what the adapter reads is NOT the encoder's output' -- was WRONG; 69-86 per cent of the DIRECTION is the encoder's output, scaled down.

POSITIVE COUNTER-EVIDENCE: sense-path norm is cleanly ARM-DEPENDENT (zworld_p0_sd070_default 1.847/2.210/2.301, mean 2.119, against ~1.45 for both other trained arms, separated on 3 of 3 seeds). If the sense path were blind to the P0a objective its norm could not track the objective this way.

PRIOR ART, decisive: V3-EXQ-978 measured sense-path r2 0.710 POSITIVE using a probe FIT ON that path. The 978-versus-1017 gap is a METHOD difference, not the extreme magnitude the first draft claimed.
